the scouts reach Circe's house; she sings at her loom; wolves and lions fawn round them
all enter but Eurylochus, who hangs back at the edge
Circe seats them, serves drugged food and wine; when they have drunk she strikes them with her wand
the men become pigs, minds intact
Circe drives them into the sties, throws acorns
Eurylochus runs back and reports: they are gone
